purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public GIS service review, bounded anonymous access, safe-field handling, and uncertainty.
assessment: The City of North Richland Hills official NRH Maps ArcGIS EnerGov service exposes a public Parcels polygon layer. Metadata, safe-field exact-point query, bounded envelope geometry query, and CRS/output behavior were inspected anonymously. One safe polygon sample was retained with only its native ParcelId identity.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official municipal GIS service and its public Parcels layer. The service metadata says TAD Parcels; this is local public GIS evidence, not a claim that every parcel is current or legally authoritative.

remainingUncertainty: The attempt did not independently validate complete current citywide coverage, parcel currency, legal-cadastre status, or adapter readiness.
